detailed_description:
VERTICAL 9:16 portrait framing, one continuous take, no cuts. Bright modern Chinese office at midday: broad soft daylight pouring through wide venetian blinds, high-key lighting, luminous pale walls, light reflective floor, every surface clearly readable, airy and open, gentle soft shadows that stay light and keep their detail, clean luminous image, high-end commercial cinematography on a large-format camera, shallow depth of field, refined natural faces, elegant wardrobe. People stay standing, framed from the knees up, camera at a normal medium distance.
Exposure: the window is a large bright key light and the whole room is filled with soft bounced daylight, so the image sits high and open across the whole tonal range. Skin tones are bright and even, with a clean luminous quality. Shadow areas sit in the light mid-tones and keep visible texture and colour. The darkest corners of the frame still read as pale grey with detail, the whites stay white, and the picture carries an even, transparent, high-key brightness from edge to edge.
Speaker labels are stable for the whole series: (S1) 苏小满, (S2) 女贵宾, (S3) 钱经理, (S4) 小唐, (S5) 阿芳, (S6) 周总监, (S7) 小罗, (S8) 陆蔓, (S9) 外婆, (S10) 张总, (S11) 医生, (S12) 前台, (S13) 陆家接线人（只在电话里，从不出现）, (S14) 陆航, (S15) 陆崇, (S16) 心腹, (S17) 收费员. Anyone not given a numbered line stays completely silent with a closed mouth.
The layout of the room stays constant all take. The people named in this beat are the only people in it and the count does not change.
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: the bright property office of 万山大厦 — the door on the LEFT of frame is a bare closed doorframe with nothing in it, the venetian-blind window and the tall wooden cabinets are on the RIGHT, the chestnut-wooden desk stands across the middle of the room. EXACTLY THREE PEOPLE are present, the same three in every single frame: 苏小满 (S1) in navy housekeeping uniform stands still on the NEAR side of the desk on the RIGHT half of frame with her back to the door; 钱经理 (S3) in a white shirt and charcoal waistcoat stands at the FAR side of the desk with his back to the window; 小唐 (S4) in a light-grey cleaning uniform stands still in the far LEFT corner of frame, flat against the wall, well inside the room and clear of the doorframe. The doorway, the corridor beyond it and the whole right-hand background stay empty of any further person for the entire take. Warm midday light comes through the blinds in long bright bands.
[Shot 1] Wide, one continuous camera move, no cut: all three people are ALREADY in the room at the very first frame and all three are visible at once — there is NO entrance, nobody walks in, the door stays shut. 钱经理 (S3) strides the two paces from the far side of the door to the far side of the desk, his charcoal waistcoat swinging and his staff badge bouncing, and comes to a stop. 苏小满 (S1) does not move at all. 小唐 (S4) does not move at all, she stays against the LEFT corner wall with only her eyes moving. The three of them are the only people in frame.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, medium over the desk: 钱经理 (S3) at the far side plants both feet wide, leans forward on straight arms and slams his open palm flat onto the desktop; the palm lands flat against the bare desk. 苏小满 (S1) holds her ground on the near side, still unmoved. 小唐 (S4) is still in the LEFT corner, unmoved. Three people, no more.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.200, closer on 钱经理's (S3) flushed face as he announces it in a loud nasal Mandarin, filing each item like a charge sheet: [Chinese] 三楼包厢。贵客丢了一只金耳钉。三万八。
[Shot 4] At 00:08.400, reverse over the desk onto 苏小满 (S1) on the near side, the blind-light barring the wall behind her: she stands perfectly still, both hands loose at her sides, chin level, eyes on him. Her mouth stays closed and she says nothing. 小唐 (S4) is still a small figure in the LEFT corner. The room is empty apart from these three.
